# California Cuts Salon

> Hair salon based in Austin, Texas. Jimmy at California Cuts is known for pixies, fades, texture and color for every hair type, including Asian hair, and clients have followed him for 15 to 20 years.

- Phone: (512) 491-8070
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Pflugerville, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Leander
- Yelp rating: 4.5 from 63 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/california-cuts-salon/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/california-cuts-salon/book.html

## Services
- Men's cuts & fades: Low fades, razor cuts and textured tops.
- Women's cuts: Pixies, layers and shape for short and long hair.
- Color & highlights: Balayage, highlights and color correction.
- Kids' cuts: Style cuts for kids, done patiently.

## About
California Cuts Salon is on North Mopac near Braker. Jimmy cuts men, women and kids, with fades, razor cuts, pixies, layers, highlights and color, and his wife runs the front with him. Clients say he listens, works with your hair type, and keeps learning at conferences every year. Newcomers from New York and beyond say he is the barber they'll keep, and whole families have sat in his chair for two decades.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment at California Cuts Salon?
  A: Appointments are best. Call (512) 491-8070 or book online and Jimmy will confirm by text.
- Q: Where is California Cuts Salon?
  A: 10515 N Mopac Expy, Ste 320, Austin, TX. Parking is right outside.
- Q: Do you cut and color all hair types?
  A: Yes. Jimmy cuts straight, wavy, curly and coarse hair, and many clients come to him specifically for Asian hair.
- Q: Can I bring inspiration photos?
  A: Please do. Photos help your stylist match the cut or color you have in mind.
- Q: What do clients say about Jimmy?
  A: California Cuts Salon is rated 4.5 stars from 63 Yelp reviews. Clients mention a stylist who listens, works with every hair type and keeps clients for decades.
